subject: Councilor Matt Leming Re-election Platform
overview: City Councilor Matt Leming appeared on the Medford Bites podcast to discuss his first term in office and his upcoming re-election campaign. He highlighted key achievements, including the city's first Prop 2.5 override, the passage of the Welcoming City Ordinance, and the ongoing comprehensive rezoning effort.

items.title: Podcast Introduction
items.summary: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan introduced the Medford Bites podcast and explained its focus on local issues.

items.title: Guest Introduction
items.summary: City Councilor Matt Leming introduced himself, discussing his day job as a health data scientist and his favorite local dining spots.

items.title: First-Term Reflections and Prop 2.5 Override
items.summary: Leming reflected on his first term and discussed the successful Prop 2.5 override that secured funding for Medford Public Schools and the DPW.

items.title: Affordable Housing and Veteran Programs
items.summary: Leming detailed efforts to fund the Affordable Housing Trust using development linkage fees and highlighted an incentive program to house veteran renters.

items.title: Public Engagement and Council Communication
items.summary: Leming outlined several new communication initiatives, including council YouTube live streams, a monthly newsletter, and his personal biweekly blog.

items.title: Welcoming City Ordinance
items.summary: Leming explained how he worked with advocacy groups to enshrine Medford's welcoming city policy as an official ordinance to protect immigrant residents.

items.title: Citywide Rezoning Plan
items.summary: Leming reviewed the goals and timeline of the city's comprehensive rezoning plan, which is slated for completion by September.

items.title: Overcoming Local Opposition
items.summary: Leming discussed navigating local opposition to zoning changes and emphasized the importance of broad resident outreach over listening only to vocal critics.

items.title: Municipal Representation
items.summary: Balocca and Leming discussed the historical barriers to entry in Medford politics and how a younger, more diverse group of progressives has changed the council.

items.title: Campaign Kickoff and Closing Remarks
items.summary: Leming announced his upcoming campaign kickoff event on June 14 and urged listeners to vote on November 4.
